notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.content:
[h2]Major changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked the "Wins/Defeats" screen now displays your statistics for the completed map
[*] Added "Star" system showing how well you passed the level
[*] Added a screen for selecting the next map which shows the available maps to choose from and how many stars you received for them
[*] Added new “element of fire” cards
[/list]
[h2]Interface changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated Manual screen
[*] Added Disclaimer
[*] Removed ready button for players, now only the lobby owner has the start game button
[*] Redesigned enemies HP bars, now you can always see the current health of your enemies regardless of its volume
[*] Added "send error report" button to the game menu
[*] Different players get different card shirts in the lobby
[*] Updated the display quality of in-game cursors
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game store now closes on esc
[*] Fixed a bug where building location was not highlighted on first launch
[*] Fixed some linguistic bugs
[*] Other changes
[*] In-game timer work was technically redesigned
[*] Reworked the difficulty on the initial "intro" level
[*] Landscape updated on all maps
[*] Added Canceling of right mouse button purchases in the store
[*] Added ability to play in 4k
[*] Reduced the distance you can zoom out maps
[/list]
